title: Crestline Fleet Credit Policy on Combined Credit Exposure
content:
Crestline Fleet Credit aggregates credit exposure across all of a business's Crestline Fleet Account holdings.

1. **Combined limit.** The combined credit limit of a business is the total of the credit limits of its fleet accounts in status applied, active or credit hold, taken on the business's portfolio on the date of the application, approval or terms change. A closed or declined account's limit is not counted.
2. **Ceiling.** The combined credit limit, including the limit being approved or raised, may not exceed the highest total of credit limits allowed by the highest-ranked program the business holds. Programs rank, from low to high: Crestline Fleet Starter, Crestline Fleet Business, Crestline Fleet Commercial, Crestline Fleet National, Crestline Fleet Enterprise, Crestline Fleet Public Sector.
3. **Reduction to fit.** When an approval or an increase would pass that ceiling, the new limit is reduced to fit within it.
4. **Decline.** When even the smallest credit limit approved on the program would not fit, the application is declined.

The rule applies to a fleet application, a fleet approval and a terms change.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures, a business whose highest-ranked program allows a combined total of 40000.00 and whose program's smallest limit is 5000.00)

| Limits already counted | Limit proposed | Room under the ceiling | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20000.00 | 25000.00 | 20000.00 | limit reduced to fit: 20000.00 |
| 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 30000.00 | 25000.00 fits as proposed |
| 37000.00 | 25000.00 | 3000.00 | even the program's smallest limit of 5000.00 does not fit: application declined |
| 20000.00 counted, plus a closed account of 15000.00 | 20000.00 | 20000.00 | the closed account is not counted; 20000.00 fits |
